subject: Cross-functional dotted-line proposal for senior product and engineering roles
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: cross-functional dotted-line structure for senior PM/Eng

Team —

I pulled together an initial proposal for introducing a dotted-line reporting model for Senior Product Managers (Sr PMs) and Senior Engineers on platform-facing work. The goal: improve alignment on cross-cutting platform priorities without disrupting current manager-level responsibilities (performance, career development, compensation).

High level:
- Sr PMs working on platform initiatives would have a dotted-line to the Platform lead for prioritization and roadmaps; their direct manager remains their product manager for reviews and calibration.
- Senior Engineers who spend >50% time on platform work would have a dotted-line to Engineering Platform for technical direction and cross-team coordination.
- Dotted-line relationships are consultative for comp/promo; formal for execution priorities.

Attached: "org-chart-v1.pdf" (draft). I included role summaries in the doc for quick reference.

Ask: please review and provide redlines by EOD Fri (Mar 4). Key questions I want resolved this week:
- Impact on performance review cycle and calibration?
- Which Sr roles (by title) should be eligible?
- Any legal/comp concerns we should loop in early?

Thanks — happy to hop on a short sync if helpful.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: org-chart-v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: cross-functional dotted-line structure for senior PM/Eng

Thanks Laura — this is a useful starting point. A few inline redlines and open items below. I've attached a quick annotated org sketch.

Inline notes (high level):
- I agree the direct manager should retain performance ownership, but we need a clear single escalation path for delivery conflicts (prioritization disagreements between product and platform). Suggest a standing monthly "alignment touch" between direct manager + dotted-line lead.
- For promotion/comp: recommend we preserve calibration pools by direct manager but require a short "impact to platform" memo for candidates with dotted-lines. That will make reviews auditable.
- Eligibility: propose limiting to Sr PM (IC4+) and Senior Eng II+ for the pilot. We can expand after one cycle.

Open: please confirm headcount and cost modelling for the pilot (cost of added manager time, any overlap). Marking Markus to own that ask.

Attachment: annotations_org-chart.pdf

Jonas Weber
VP, Platform Programs
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: annotations_org-chart.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Mar 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: cross-functional dotted-line structure for senior PM/Eng

Looping in a few fiscal and comp considerations. I reviewed the draft and sketched a simple cost-impact model (attached). Key points:

- Banding: we must avoid creating two parallel ladders that confuse compensation committees. Any dotted-line responsibilities that materially change scope should map to an existing band increase or documented stretch assignment.
- Review load: dotted-line leads attending manager calibration will add ~20-30% more time to the calibration process per cycle — we should quantify and budget for that.
- Headcount: if we formalize dotted-line leads (e.g., Platform Lead for Sr PMs), we may need one senior program manager to coordinate cross-team logistics for the pilot.

Attached: role-summaries.xlsx, cost-impact-model.csv

I recommend we run a 6-week pilot with 6-8 people and then assess impact on review friction and product delivery. If we proceed, I will work with Finance to estimate FY27 run-rate impact.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: cost-impact-model.csv (text/csv)]

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 09:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: cross-functional dotted-line structure for senior PM/Eng

High-level: thumbs up from me on the approach. A few operational asks before we finalize:

- Comms plan: we need manager talking points, FAQ, and a 30-minute all-hands for affected teams. Can Laura own the talking points and the first draft of the FAQ?
- Pilot cohort: recommend we pick a pilot cohort that includes one team from each major product area (Search, Relevance, Platform) to test cross-context friction.
- Risk: outline rollback criteria up front (e.g., >15% increase in missed SLAs for 2 consecutive sprints). Put those in the pilot charter.

I'll offer to run the town-hall and help with Q&A. If People Ops can finalize the cost model next week, we can announce the pilot the week of Mar 15.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
SVP, Product
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Proposal: cross-functional dotted-line structure for senior PM/Eng — final draft and next steps

Thanks everyone — I incorporated Jonas's redlines and Markus's ask points and updated the pilot charter.

Attachments: org-chart-v2.pdf, role-summaries.xlsx (updated), cost-impact-model.csv (updated)

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Markus: finalize cost-impact model and FY27 run-rate estimate — due Wed Mar 10.
- Jonas: draft alignment touch template (monthly sync agenda) and escalation flow — due Fri Mar 12.
- Laura: publish manager talking points + FAQ and set town-hall for Mar 17 — due Tue Mar 9.
- Lauren: lead town-hall content and Q&A — Mar 17 session owner.
- Claire (HR consultant): review promo/comp wording and provide legal/benchmarks — due Tue Mar 9.

If there are no substantive objections by Tue Mar 9 EOD, we'll move forward with the pilot announcement on Fri Mar 12 and kickoff Mar 15 planning.
